metadata.title: Refugio
metadata.description: A quiet exchange of honest human presence.

arrivalIntro.welcomeBody: You don't need the right words. Only a moment of honesty.
arrivalIntro.howHeadline:
Something real goes in.
Something human echoes back.
arrivalIntro.privacy: Refugio compares meaning privately. It never writes a reply and never shows your entry to another visitor.
arrivalIntro.presenceBody: Only the phrase you choose to leave at the end can become part of Refugio and support someone else.

rulesGate.title: BEFORE YOU ENTER
rulesGate.p1: It's anonymous — no accounts, no names, no photos. Here, honesty costs less than hiding does.
rulesGate.p2: It's not a chat — no one replies to you directly. What you see here is real, human, from someone else.
rulesGate.p3: It doesn't replace professional help — if you need to talk to someone right now, there's real help at <link>{url}</link>.

arrive.tagline: You don't have to prove anything.
arrive.subcopy:
This is a safe place
to be who you are.

remember.headline: Before you continue, a moment alone.
remember.subcopy: Is there a moment — recent or distant — when you were completely yourself, expecting nothing in return?

write.headline: What would you like someone else to understand about you?
write.subcopy: It can be an emotion, a doubt, or something you still don't know how to name. You don't need to tell the whole story. Write only what you can leave here today and let go.
write.placeholder: There's something I haven't known how to say...

outcome.crisisIntro: You're not alone. If you feel like you need to talk to someone right now, here's help:
outcome.generalFlagged: Your text couldn't be published this time.
outcome.capReached: We've used up today's space, come back tomorrow.

observe.caption:
Every light you see
is someone who dared
to show themselves for a moment.

observe.transitionCaption: a moment to find each other

mirror.noMatchQuote: The system is quiet, but you are not the first in this void.
mirror.subcopyMatched: Their words were already here, waiting.
mirror.subcopyNoMatch: Nothing echoed back this time. Not every feeling finds its match here — that's the corpus's limit, not yours.

gratitude.headline: Thank you for letting yourself be here.

leaveATrace.writingTagline: Your presence can also transform this place.
leaveATrace.writingHeadline: Leave something for whoever arrives next.
leaveATrace.writingSubcopy: It doesn't have to be profound. It can be a phrase you would have wanted to find when you arrived. Maybe it will stay with someone else.
leaveATrace.placeholder: Leave a phrase, if you'd like...
leaveATrace.doneHeadline:
Your presence is now
also part
of this ecosystem.
leaveATrace.skippedSubcopy: And leaving nothing is also a way of being here.

contribute.headline: Leave a phrase for Refugio's wall.
contribute.subcopyIntro: This isn't a chat, and it doesn't replace professional help — if you need to talk to someone right now, there's real help at <link>{url}</link>.
contribute.subcopyBody1: Refugio is a place for leaving — and finding — a reflection of ourselves in others. Like a wall of anonymous notes, not a journal or a therapy app. Someone arriving should feel that real people were here before them, not read something written just to fill space.
contribute.subcopyBody2: No tags, no signatures, no need to sound a certain way. A full thought, a fragment, a half-formed idea — all of it counts. Whatever you're actually feeling is enough, no need to reach for variety. You can leave more than one.
contribute.hint: If it helps: maybe something from today — the frustration of a stuck prompt, the tiredness by hour six, the moment something finally clicked.
contribute.placeholder: write one, just as it is...
contribute.saved: Added. Leave another whenever you're ready.
